data.one_liner: Apple platform implementation of the workmanager plugin for iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides background task scheduling using iOS background fetch, BGTaskScheduler, and macOS NSBackgroundActivityScheduler. It is automatically included when using the workmanager package.
use_when: Implement background tasks on iOS or macOS
Need to schedule one-off or periodic work
avoid_when: Using a cross-platform background task solution that already supports iOS/macOS
strengths: Fully integrated with workmanager, no extra dependency needed
weaknesses: Only works on iOS and macOS
No support for Android or other platforms
